contracts.name: ConfirmedInput v2

invariants: Original and rewrite safety checks precede acceptance; a refused original cannot be laundered by rewriting.
Pending ownership + expiry + CAS single-consumption precede any authority issuance.
Changing person, topic, card, orientation or spread invalidates old confirmation/artifacts; no re-draw.
The executor uses effective_topic and its digest, not the original topic or spread slug.
contracts.compatibility: Keep raw v1 input for audit metadata only; adapt trusted SessionResult.effective_topic into v2. Legacy executor intake is internal-only and must not create a second confirmation loop. Unknown fields rejected per version.
contracts.necessity: One canonical confirmed fact set prevents the current session/executor topic split; this does not add an approval system.

contracts.name: Runtime authority and operation policy
contracts.producer: existing reading authority DB + authenticated RuntimeController
contracts.consumer: stage stores / Research worker / delivery transaction

fields.authority_sha256: existing authority digest, never client assertion
fields.ttl_seconds: explicit positive value <= published server maximum; absent means HOLD
fields.research_budget: separate A/B max 3 attempts, explicit network grant; no Harness budget substitution
fields.operation_nonce: idempotency nonce bound to reading + input version
fields.rejudge_budget: explicit bounded parent budget; absent means no automatic child run

invariants: A Development Harness grant cannot issue or imply runtime authority.
No stage semantics enter source records.
LN shares identity/authority mechanisms, never Tarot stage enum meanings.
Replays cannot bypass expiry or revocation; a pre-existing delivered answer may be read only with authenticated read permission, not regenerated.
contracts.compatibility: Tarot v1 stage_allowlist remains decoded exactly. Proposed v2 adds system-discriminated operation_allowlist on the same authority lineage; no parallel LN approval ledger. Migration and SQL owner O-DB, semantics owner O-RUNTIME.
contracts.necessity: Needed because the existing store protocol is Tarot-stage-shaped and LN must not masquerade as R1–R4.

contracts.name: Frozen artifact and review manifest v2
contracts.producer: stage assembler + existing sealed-artifact store
contracts.consumer: subsequent stage / isolated reviewer / delivery verifier

fields.content: immutable exact UTF-8 payload; separate private structural appendix from model-visible text
fields.digests: content_sha256, artifact_sha256, ordered parent digests, input digest, contract version
fields.dependencies: actual source snapshot/item digests and research claim-set digest
fields.retention: expires_at bounded by published artifact TTL; no long-term or user export copy
fields.model_receipt: actual adapter build/model family/context/capability profile; an isolation flag is not proof

invariants: Verify exact bytes, identity, ordered parents and TTL at every consume, not only initial seal.
Governance, raw sources, audit reports, long-term profiles and secrets cannot enter model-visible material.
Source IDs remain in private appendix; model gets only minimal approved content and local ephemeral evidence handles.
No same-stage overwrite; same request replay returns identical hash after authority check; different bytes fail.
R4 sees only this manifest and frozen R1–R3 material, with zero retrieval/model tools other than its own completion.
contracts.compatibility: Use explicit digest_version: v1 hashes unchanged; v2 domain-separated canonical fields plus exact content hash. Do not claim Python sort_keys alone is JCS; reuse the repository canonicalization contract and cross-language vectors in S05.
contracts.necessity: Preserves provenance that the current executor loses when reducing evidence to strings and sealing approved_source_refs=().

contracts.name: R2MatchSeed / Mentor query binding
contracts.producer: PROPOSED_NEW stages/r2.py::derive_match_seed after R1 + symbol detail + optional Book T

fields.card_bindings: actual card and orientation, never inferred
fields.mechanism_candidates: supported mechanism descriptions + upstream evidence handles + condition boundaries
fields.registry_binding: approved registry/version used to resolve mechanism_ref
fields.result: resolved match query or optional-layer no-match; never final R2 phenomenon

invariants: No field depends on final R2 artifact/phenomenon.
The data consumer receives scalar filters and an opaque runtime binding, not an R1 artifact or stage instructions.
Natural-language vocabulary absence is not missing source evidence: bounded registry mapping can succeed with an explicit evidence-backed mapping receipt.
No resolved approved mechanism_ref means card-specific no-match, not synthesizing a mechanism from candidate summaries.
Global course process is a separately approved scope; it cannot create card meaning or rescue an unmatched card-specific entry.
failures: NO_APPROVED_EVIDENCE for an existing layer with no valid matching mapping
NO_LAYER_MATCH / NO_SNAPSHOT according to Source Lifecycle
contracts.compatibility: This is one runtime-local preparation DTO. Existing MentorQuery/MechanismRef types remain downstream; add an explicit adapter, not fields to raw course records.
contracts.necessity: Breaks the documented circular dependency between Mentor matching and the final R2 phenomenon while preserving R2 evidence order.

contracts.name: System-tagged frozen interpretation origin -> ResearchSeedPacket v2
contracts.producer: Tarot: coherent final R2 after optional layers; Lenormand: coherent authorized COMPOSE artifact after approved support graph evaluation

fields.mechanism: supported phenomenon/mechanism, not card meaning lookup text
fields.conditions: current user-provided constraints / explicit unknowns, with private evidence links
fields.forbidden_payload: names/contact/exact location/date/private narrative/source labels/whole reading text

fields.vectors: ASCII/Chinese/emoji/combining forms, null/empty, key/order changes, UTC offsets, boolean/int, forbidden NaN/Infinity/float ambiguity, duplicate JSON keys, source chunk rearrangement

invariants: Codec name+version part of domain; no silently equal cross-codec digest
Snapshot.source_sha256 cannot mean one physical file for multi-source snapshot: source manifest hash versioned and separate member raw_source_sha256
Provenance resolution must validate raw byte bounds, not only nonempty opaque IDs
UUID conversion canonical lowercase hyphen form; invalid OpaqueId for real reading refuses, synthetic path explicitly separate
Frozen candidate hash change invalidates former approval; recomputing approval fields locally does not create approval
contracts.compatibility: Use existing LPTE v1 for old records; v2 explicit serialization spec + cross-language vectors before real adoption; RFC JCS only if separately selected/verifiably implemented, not json.dumps(sort_keys=True) New v2 uses the explicit codec in HASH_CODEC_V2.md, not a claim to be existing LPTE or RFC JCS.
contracts.necessity: Closes DS real-input hash holes without recreating a full generic serialization platform.

contracts.name: New product entry HTTP/host API
contracts.producer: browser/host adapter

fields.intake: system, spread_id/version, user topic, card refs + Tarot orientation only, draw order, defined position facts, same-person/new-person/unknown claim; no memory/profile field
fields.confirmation: opaque pending_ref, pending_version, selected option or allowed original; same-session CSRF and idempotency key
fields.run: server-side confirmed-input ref and explicit UI request; opaque client run_handle maps to internal reading id privately
fields.response: finite UI state + safe message + allowed user actions + expiry/deadline + public answer only after controlled committed delivery
fields.error: safe error class/action only; backend reason, identities/hashes/Provider/DB details private

invariants: Browser cannot post approved/skip_gate/DSN/model/profile identifiers as authority
Changing person/cards/topic invalidates pending; selected rewrite MUST become effective topic
GET/status read never triggers/retries model/Provider call; POST run/cancel idempotent and principal-bound
UI has no raw/governance/DB/model connection; host adapter calls approved services only
No invented account facts; principal is opaque session identity, not user profile
contracts.failures: 403 session/CSRF; 409 stale confirm/state conflict; 422 factual shape; 429 configured limit; 503 unavailable; all without content/credentials in logs
contracts.compatibility: Reuse D demo validation/projection concepts via adapters, keep local demo loopback/preview; new product paths explicit PROPOSED_NEW and no PHP assumptions
contracts.necessity: Actual browser flow needs confirmed-input/run/status/cancel boundary; avoids UI owning a second workflow/approval system.

contracts.name: Public answer and state projection v2
contracts.producer: DB readback of approved delivery + S04 terminal aggregate

fields.view: UI state, run_kind, safe status/next action, bounded deadline; transient opaque UI handle not internal IDs
fields.answer: natural text, verified source name+https URL, honest research notice; never raw seals/approval tokens/registry IDs
fields.optional: state-only notice for absence; contributed text only if approved and included in final answer
fields.terminal: LIVE_READING only committed answer; preview/block/not_attempted never carry successful research or answer

invariants: Source names/URLs are permitted when bound; do not ban arbitrary public names or numbers by engineering keyword substring
No R4 unreviewed streaming; progress uses safe finite states only
Research two-channel + two-kind aggregate comes from S04, not simplistic one outcome coercion
Expiry/retention deletes server answer copy with research-derived material per IC-15; client-held copy cannot be technically clawed back and must not be claimed deleted
Accessibility and content safety do not impose fixed opening/closing phrases on answers
contracts.failures: EXPIRED / STOPPED / NO_RELIABLE_SOLUTION / SEARCH_FAILED / SOURCE_UNUSABLE / NOT_ATTEMPTED with distinct honest explanation
contracts.compatibility: V1 VisibleAnswerView adapted, do not equate label LIVE_READING with trusted delivery; require server proof out of public DTO
contracts.necessity: Necessary separation of engineering metadata and human answer; content-matching privacy rules alone are insufficient.
